purpose: The build behind the race and stage views published beside this file: what code ran, on what evidence, with which parameters, on which machine, and exactly what it produced. The commit named below is the one the export ran from, which is the parent of the commit carrying this file — a manifest is written before it is committed, so it cannot name the commit it ends up inside. `make verify-manifest` recomputes the output hashes and holds this tree to them.

schema.head: 0111_three_organisers_publish_their_own_finishing_order.sql
schema.note: The applied-migration ledger, not the directory listing. A migration present in the repository and absent from the database would change what the queries below could read, so the database's own record is what this states.

pipeline.note: Version strings imported from the exporters, never copied. A manifest that restates a constant can be wrong about it.

parameters.note: The exporters' own named constants, imported at emit time. Thresholds belonging to the derive stage are deliberately not repeated here: every derived field already travels with its formula id, version, expression, units and limitations in each product's `index.json` manifest, and a second copy in a second file is a second thing to go stale.

not_captured.python_dependencies: No lockfile exists. psycopg and pypdf are installed by name, so the versions above are the only ones this build can read; nothing is claimed about the rest of the interpreter's environment.
not_captured.operating_system_packages: The PostgreSQL and PostGIS strings above are what the server reports about itself. The build does not enumerate the host's packages and does not pretend to.

inputs.note: One digest per source over the SHA-256 of every artifact captured from it, and one over the vault as a whole. The artifacts themselves are not redistributable and are not published; their hashes are what lets a rebuilder establish they hold the same evidence rather than merely the same source names.

shared.note: The fleet index. It describes every race at once, so it belongs to none of them.

not_covered.build.json: A digest cannot cover the file that carries it. No self-hash is emitted, because a number computed over this file with its own hash removed would look like an integrity check and would not be one.
not_covered.registers: The files listed under `outside_scope` are written by `make registers`, which runs after `make export` and therefore after this manifest. Hashing them here would record the previous run's bytes under this run's name.
